challengeStages.title: 01 · Take your first ticket
challengeStages.description: Establish a baseline and add useful coverage.

challengeStages.title: 02 · Investigate before guessing
challengeStages.description: Separate a symptom from a cause; observe the right state.

challengeStages.description: Repair isolation, uncertain writes and runtime contracts.

challengeStages.title: 04 · Deliver evidence
challengeStages.description: Report actual coverage, execute a cloud smoke and hand over a decision.

challenges.title: Inherit the project

challenges.subtitle: Repair nested shared data and prove independence.

challenges.subtitle: Reconcile an uncertain write without submitting again.

assignmentTopics.title: Test design and oracles
assignmentTopics.description: Choose requirements, boundaries and evidence worth trusting.

assignmentTopics.title: Locators and screen contracts
assignmentTopics.description: Find the intended control and ask for useful testability.

assignmentTopics.title: Synchronization and timing
assignmentTopics.description: Distinguish current results, business outcomes and timeout causes.

assignmentTopics.title: Test data and contracts
assignmentTopics.description: Validate runtime data and plan safe fixture ownership.

assignmentTopics.title: Commerce in another app
assignmentTopics.description: Practise catalog, cart and checkout workflows.

assignmentTopics.title: Android state and usability
assignmentTopics.description: Observe modal, text-size and lifecycle transitions.

assignmentTopics.title: Hybrid and integration boundaries
assignmentTopics.description: Separate context, driver and external-content evidence.

assignmentTopics.title: Delivery and team evidence
assignmentTopics.description: Select checks, combine artifacts and explain a decision.

assignmentLevels.title: L1 · Guided
assignmentLevels.description: A concrete contract and a small focused result.

assignmentLevels.title: L2 · Independent
assignmentLevels.description: Choose your structure and justify the boundary.

assignmentLevels.title: L3 · Investigation
assignmentLevels.description: Reconcile evidence and hand over a decision.

assignments.title: Turn a delivery rule into examples
assignments.summary: Turn a pricing requirement into boundary examples and a focused coverage choice.

assignments.title: Challenge a weak oracle
assignments.summary: Implement an exact quote matcher and prove that a weak assertion misses wrong fees.

assignments.title: Negotiate a small release scope
assignments.summary: Select useful checks under a device-time budget and revise the plan when the risk changes.

assignments.title: Identify a row with repeated labels
assignments.summary: Select a unique visible record by identity even when labels and positions repeat.

assignments.title: Own a native widget test
assignments.summary: Inspect an unfamiliar native widget and automate two meaningful state transitions.
assignments.deliverable: Isolated widget spec and observed run

assignments.title: Hand over a testability request
assignments.summary: Use hierarchy evidence to propose a stable identity contract and an interim selector.

assignments.title: Ignore an outdated search response
assignments.summary: Write an event reducer that preserves the newest request despite out-of-order responses.

assignments.title: Observe a business outcome
assignments.summary: Wait for the right settled receipt rather than treating a vanished spinner as success.

assignments.title: Explain where the time went
assignments.summary: Separate nested command time, condition time and diagnostic time before changing a timeout.

assignments.title: Validate a price feed
assignments.summary: Validate unknown catalog records without coercing prices or leaking extra data.

assignments.title: Plan cleanup without deleting data
assignments.summary: Create a dry-run cleanup plan using exact ownership, state and expiry rules.

assignments.title: Support a schema rollout
assignments.summary: Normalize two explicit payload versions while rejecting ambiguous fallback behavior.

assignments.title: Add and remove the intended product
assignments.summary: Transfer your test skills to a second app by proving product identity through cart changes.

assignments.title: Check cart arithmetic and isolation
assignments.summary: Verify two-product quantities and totals with independent setup and reversed test order.
assignments.deliverable: Cart arithmetic specs and isolation evidence

assignments.title: Investigate an interrupted checkout
assignments.summary: Explore checkout back/cancel behavior and explain which apparent success lacks a backend oracle.
assignments.deliverable: Checkout state map and investigation packet

assignments.title: Dismiss a modal without losing the screen
assignments.summary: Inspect and test Android Back while a native modal is open.
assignments.deliverable: Modal dismissal spec and state evidence

assignments.title: Test a screen with larger text
assignments.summary: Compare the same journey at baseline and larger text while preserving device settings.

assignments.title: Map what a restart really resets
assignments.summary: Compare navigation, backgrounding and process restart without resetting the experiment midway.

assignments.title: Classify three WebView failures
assignments.summary: Distinguish context discovery, driver attachment and page-content failures from supplied evidence.

assignments.title: Preserve the original context failure
assignments.summary: Implement cleanup behavior that preserves the original failure and reports a second failure.

assignments.title: Investigate a real WebView boundary
assignments.summary: Inspect actual contexts, attempt one DOM observation and hand over execution or a precise blocker.

assignments.title: Make test selection a contract
assignments.summary: Select required checks from changed areas and fail visibly when the selection input is unknown.

assignments.title: Merge evidence without hiding a missing shard
assignments.summary: Validate run identity and expected shards before summarizing reported tests.

assignments.title: Hand over a decision under uncertainty
assignments.summary: Reconcile cross-app, build and shard evidence into a concise release recommendation.
